summary: Iovance Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, solely to disclose that it updated its corporate presentation used at healthcare conferences and with analysts and stockholders. The filing includes the presentation as Exhibit 99.1 but contains no transaction, terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. No special situation is present; this is a routine disclosure update with no event triggering an activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special category.
